title: Pure True Draco
summary: Pure True Draco control strategy, built around Tribute Summoned Wyrm monsters that can Tribute face-up Continuous Spells and Continuous Traps instead of monsters. The deck leverages devastating backrow destruction on departure, continuous resource generation, and oppressive floodgates without needing an Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dragonic Diagram destroys a card in your hand or field to search any True Draco or True King card from your Deck, simultaneously triggering the GY destruction effects of your Continuous Spells and Traps.
True Draco Heritage grants an extra Tribute Summon of a True Draco monster and draws up to 3 cards based on how many True Draco card types were sent from field to GY that turn.
Disciples of the True Dracophoenix grants an additional Tribute Summon and recycles 3 True Draco cards from your GY to draw 1 card.
Card of Demise and Pot of Duality dig deep for continuous backrow and True Draco monsters with zero drawback under the deck's purely Tribute Summon playstyle.
Terraforming searches Dragonic Diagram directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Diagram + Continuous Spell + True Draco
steps: Activate True Draco Heritage (or Disciples of the True Dracophoenix) in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Activate Dragonic Diagram, using its effect to destroy True Draco Heritage and search Ignis Heat, the True Dracowarrior.
True Draco Heritage triggers upon being sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, targeting and destroying an opponent's Spell or Trap Card.
Tribute Summon Ignis Heat, the True Dracowarrior using Dragonic Diagram or another Continuous Spell/Trap as Tribute.
Set True King's Return or True Draco Apocalypse, ready to react to any card activation by the opponent.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Master Peace, the True Dracoslaying King can be Tribute Summoned by Tributing 2 Continuous Spells, Traps, or monsters, gaining complete immunity to cards matching the original card types of those Tributes, and banishes a Continuous Spell or Trap from GY as a Quick Effect to destroy a card on the field.
Ignis Heat, the True Dracowarrior adds or face-up activates a True Draco Continuous Spell from your Deck whenever the opponent activates a card or effect.
Dinomight Knight, the True Dracofighter adds or face-up activates a True Draco Continuous Trap from your Deck whenever the opponent activates a card or effect.
Majesty Maiden, the True Dracocaster adds any True Draco monster (including Master Peace) from Deck to hand whenever the opponent activates a card or effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: True King's Return can Tribute Summon a True Draco monster during the opponent's Main Phase, and targets and destroys 1 monster on the field when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY.
True Draco Apocalypse halves the ATK and DEF of all face-up opponent monsters, enables a Tribute Summon during the opponent's Main Phase, and destroys 1 monster on the field when sent to the GY.
Crackdown steals an opponent's monster, allowing both Crackdown and the stolen monster to be used as Tribute for a True Draco Tribute Summon.
Skill Drain and Lose 1 Turn shut down opponent monster effects on field; you can Tribute them away at will when you need to resolve your own monster effects.

allow.Card of Demise: Limited to 1 in TCG: draws until you have 3 cards in your hand after setting your Continuous Spells/Traps—and because True Draco Tribute Summons instead of Special Summoning, you suffer zero penalty from its Special Summon lock!
allow.Pot of Duality: Excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck and adds 1 to your hand—completely free in True Draco since your entire engine Tribute Summons instead of Special Summoning!
allow.Crackdown: Continuous Trap that steals control of an opponent's monster—and because Crackdown is a face-up Continuous Trap Card, you can then Tribute either Crackdown OR the stolen monster to Tribute Summon a True Draco monster (or Master Peace!) during either player's turn!
allow.Lose 1 Turn: Continuous Trap that can be activated while you control no Special Summoned monsters (which True Draco never does!): negates the effects of all Special Summoned monsters during the turn they are Special Summoned and switches them to Defense Position, and can be Tributed for a True Draco or Master Peace!
allow.Skill Drain: Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap that negates all face-up monster effects on the field—and whenever you want to resolve Ignis Heat, Dinomight Knight, or Master Peace on the field, you simply Tribute your own face-up Skill Drain to Tribute Summon another True Draco or banish it from GY for Master Peace's Quick Effect!
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Dragonic Diagram from your Deck.

main: Master Peace, the True Dracoslaying King

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Wyrm boss (2950 ATK / 2950 DEF; legal in TCG!): can be Tribute Summoned by Tributing 2 Continuous Spells, Traps, and/or monsters; becomes completely UNAFFECTED by the effects of cards with the same card type (Monster, Spell, and/or Trap) as the original card type of the cards Tributed for its Tribute Summon; and once per turn (Quick Effect), banishes 1 Continuous Spell/Trap from your GY to destroy 1 other card on the field!
Ignis Heat, the True Dracowarrior

Core Level 5 FIRE Wyrm (2400 ATK): can be Tribute Summoned in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Continuous Spell/Trap; once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect while you control this Tribute Summoned card (Quick Effect), adds or activates 1 'True Draco' or 'True King' Continuous Spell directly from your Deck!
Dinomight Knight, the True Dracofighter

Core Level 6 WATER Wyrm (2500 ATK): can be Tribute Summoned in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Continuous Spell/Trap; once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect while you control this Tribute Summoned card (Quick Effect), adds or activates 1 'True Draco' or 'True King' Continuous Trap directly from your Deck!
Majesty Maiden, the True Dracocaster

Core Level 5 WIND Wyrm (2300 ATK): can be Tribute Summoned in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Continuous Spell/Trap; once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect while you control this Tribute Summoned card (Quick Effect), adds ANY 'True Draco' or 'True King' monster (including Master Peace!) from your Deck to your hand!
Dragonic Diagram

Limited to 1 in TCG: iconic Field Spell that prevents each Tribute Summoned 'True Draco' or 'True King' monster from being destroyed by battle once per turn, and destroys 1 other card in your hand or field (triggering your True Draco Spells/Traps' GY destruction effects!) to add ANY 'True Draco' or 'True King' card from your Deck to your hand!
True Draco Heritage

Core Continuous Spell: draws cards during your Main Phase equal to the number of different card types (Monster, Spell, Trap) among 'True Draco' and 'True King' cards sent from the field to the GY this turn (up to 3 cards!); grants an extra True Draco Tribute Summon during your Main Phase; and destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field if sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY!
Disciples of the True Dracophoenix

Core Continuous Spell: targets 3 'True Draco' and/or 'True King' cards in your GY, shuffles them into the Deck, and draws 1 card; grants an extra True Draco Tribute Summon during your Main Phase; and destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field if sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY!
True King's Return

Core Continuous Trap: revives 1 'True Draco' or 'True King' monster from your GY in Defense Position; during your opponent's Main Phase, immediately Tribute Summons 1 'True Draco' or 'True King' monster face-up; and if sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY (by being Tributed on the opponent's turn!), targets 1 monster on the field and destroys it!
True Draco Apocalypse

Core Continuous Trap: destroys 1 other 'True Draco' or 'True King' card you control (triggering its GY destruction effect!) to halve the ATK and DEF of ALL face-up monsters your opponent currently controls; Tribute Summons 1 True Draco during your opponent's Main Phase; and destroys 1 monster on the field if sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY!
Card of Demise
Limited to 1 in TCG: draws until you have 3 cards in your hand.
Pot of Duality
Excavates 3 cards and adds 1 to your hand with zero conflict since True Draco Tribute Summons.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Dragonic Diagram.
Crackdown
Continuous Trap that steals an opponent's monster and serves as a Continuous Trap Tribute (along with the stolen monster!) for Master Peace or Ignis Heat.
Lose 1 Turn
Continuous Trap floodgate that negates Special Summoned monsters' effects and switches them to Defense Position while you control only Tribute Summoned True Dracos.
Skill Drain
Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap that negates monster effects on the field and can be Tributed away at will for a True Draco Tribute Summon.
